title: Creating Databases & Tables
description: Define table schemas with CREATE TABLE, specifying column names and SQL data types.

blocks.content:
Use `CREATE TABLE` to define new table schemas:

```sql
CREATE TABLE books (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT,
  price REAL
);
```
Common SQLite data types: `INTEGER`, `TEXT`, `REAL` (floats), `BLOB`, `NUMERIC`.

blocks.prompt: Create a table named `courses` with columns `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY`, `title TEXT`, and `credits INTEGER`. Then insert a row (1, "SQL Basics", 3) and select all.
blocks.answer_sql: CREATE TABLE courses (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, credits INTEGER); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (1, "SQL Basics", 3); SELECT * FROM courses;
